cost_assumptions.units: illustrative relative units, not medical costs

validation_reference_models.candidate: baseline: Age + BMI only | Logistic Regression

model_search.method: RandomizedSearchCV with 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; Average Precision scored on 10,000 stratified training rows; up to 16 draws per model (finite spaces may be smaller).

validation_uncertainty.interpretation: Bootstrap intervals are exploratory; model selection and feature experiments reused validation data.

explanation.method: Exact Shapley values over the questions, on the probability scale, relative to the average of a 256-row training background. Contributions add up to (your estimate - background average).

bmi_handling: Original BMI values retained; no upper cap
selection_rule: Run a 3-fold grouped randomized search with 16 randomized parameter draws per course model on a stratified 10,000-row training sample. Among eight-input candidates whose validation ROC-AUC is within 0.010 of the best full-feature baseline, select the highest validation Average Precision. Refit that candidate on the full training partition, select its operating threshold on the full validation partition using FP=1 and FN=5, then evaluate once on the untouched test set.

audit.bmi_handling: Original BMI values retained; no upper cap

split_method: Approximately 60/20/20 folds over unique full 21-feature profiles, stratified by each profile majority target; all original rows for a profile stay in one partition. Original rows retained; no respondent IDs available.
imbalance: No oversampling or class weights: retain original prevalence and probability scale. Asymmetric validation cost selects operating threshold. Report PR-AUC, Brier, recall and precision; accuracy is not selection criterion.
intended_use: Educational retrospective classification of a self-reported BRFSS 2015 survey label. Not a screening, triage, diagnosis, individual clinical probability, or future-onset model. The source population includes respondents with prior diagnoses; the app makes no undiagnosed-population claim.
target_population_alignment: The outcome combines self-reported diabetes/prediabetes, including previously diagnosed respondents. The feature set does not identify undiagnosed disease. Consequently, the application is explicitly framed as a survey-label classification demonstration rather than an undiagnosed screening tool.
